positions.title: AI/ML Engineer
positions.description:
Architected real-time object detection pipelines using YOLOv8 and Detectron2, processing 120 FPS from vehicle camera feeds, which reduced perception latency by 30%.
Lowered model inference latency by 35% through TensorRT optimization and INT8 quantization on NVIDIA Orin edge units, enabling sub-50ms response times.
Automated data labeling validation system with Python and OpenCV, improving annotation accuracy from 88% to 96% across 500K+ frames, saving 200 manual review hours.
Configured A/B testing framework for model versions using MLflow and Kubernetes, enabling rapid experimentation without service interruption and accelerating iteration by 40%.
Implemented drift detection using Evidently Al and Prometheus, triggering automated retraining when feature distribution shifted beyond 5%, preventing accuracy degradation.
Generated synthetic training data with GANs and PyTorch to augment rare driving scenarios, boosting edge-case recall by 42% and reducing real-world testing needs.
Deployed models to NVIDIA Orin-based edge units using Docker and Kubernetes, achieving 99.9% uptime across 500+ vehicles in production fleet.
Built CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions and AWS SageMaker, reducing model deployment time from days to under 2 hours with zero rollback incidents.
Created Grafana dashboards to monitor real-time inference metrics, reducing debugging turnaround by 50% and enabling proactive alerting for performance anomalies.

positions.title: AI/ML Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed fraud detection system using XGBoost and Apache Spark, processing 2M+ daily transactions with 99.2% precision, reducing false positives by 35% for banking client.
Automated feature engineering pipeline with Spark and Databricks, reducing manual effort by 70% and accelerating model iteration from weeks to 3 days per release.
Forecasted time-series inventory demand using LightGBM and Prophet, decreasing stockouts by 25% across 500+ retail locations and improving forecast accuracy by 18%.
Orchestrated end-to-end ML workflows using Apache Airflow and Docker, cutting deployment time from 3 weeks to 3 days with full reproducibility and audit trails.
Containerized legacy scoring scripts with Docker and deployed on AWS ECS, enabling seamless migration from on-prem servers and reducing infrastructure costs by 20%.
Created interactive dashboards in Streamlit connected to PostgreSQL, allowing business stakeholders to query model predictions and explanations, boosting adoption by 40%.
Built RESTful API using FastAPI to serve real-time predictions, handling 10K+ concurrent requests with sub-200ms latency and 99.95% availability.
Implemented model version control using DVC and Git, enabling rollback to any previous model within minutes and improving collaboration across 5 team members.
Designed A/B testing framework with AWS Lambda and CloudWatch, comparing champion vs challenger models on live traffic, increasing conversion rate by 12% for retail client.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Constructed predictive maintenance system using sensor data from 10K+ production machines with PySpark and XGBoost, detecting failures 48 hours in advance at 94% accuracy.
Reduced unplanned downtime by 30% through real-time anomaly detection deployed via MQTT and Kafka streams, saving $2M annually in lost production costs.
Extracted vibration and thermal features using signal processing in Python, improving model ROC-AUC from 0.82 to 0.91 and reducing false alarms by 25%.
Tuned Spark Structured Streaming jobs to handle 500K+ events/sec with exactly-once processing guarantees, ensuring zero data loss for critical machine telemetry.
Established automated model retraining trigger in Airflow based on performance decay exceeding 3% over 7-day windows, maintaining model freshness without manual intervention.
Integrated SHAP explanations into maintenance alerts via REST API, enabling root cause analysis and reducing troubleshooting time by 40% for plant engineers.
Designed Grafana dashboards with InfluxDB to visualize machine health scores and remaining useful life (RUL), adopted by 50+ plant managers for daily decisions.
Built ETL pipelines using PySpark and TimescaleDB to aggregate 5TB of raw sensor data weekly, reducing query latency from 30 seconds to under 2 seconds.
Containerized streaming applications with Docker and deployed on on-prem Kubernetes cluster, achieving 99.5% uptime and reducing deployment failures by 60%.
